texts: Here is the whole of it: choose what you want, pay for it in the shop, and we send it to your door. Delivery and returns details sit further down the page.
Look through the products and prices on the site, then sign up to open the shop.
Prices are in pounds. Pay in the shop and you are done; no steps you don't need.
We pack it, post it, and it turns up at your door. The times are under Delivery.
We'll add our delivery details here soon.
We'll add our returns details here soon.
Now you know how it works.
Sign up once and the shop opens for you. Browse the products first if you would rather see the prices.
Plain, useful things for the home and the garden, chosen by Donkey and sent out from our workshop.
Donkey, a small shop for everyday things.

Orders arrive in 3 to 5 days. We post to mainland UK addresses with a tracked service, and you will get the tracking number by email the day your parcel leaves us. Postage is £3.95 on orders under £30, and free above that.

Changed your mind? Send anything back within 30 days, as long as it is unused and still in its packaging. Email us with your order number and we will send a returns label. Refunds go back to the card you paid with within 5 working days of the parcel reaching us.

texts: Here is the whole of it: choose what you want, pay for it in the shop, and we send it to your door. Delivery and returns details sit further down the page.
Look through the products and prices on the site, then sign up to open the shop.
Prices are in pounds. Pay in the shop and you are done; no steps you don't need.
We pack it, post it, and it turns up at your door. The times are under Delivery.
We'll add our delivery details here soon.
We'll add our returns details here soon.
Now you know how it works.
Sign up once and the shop opens for you. Browse the products first if you would rather see the prices.
Plain, useful things for the home and the garden, chosen by Donkey and sent out from our workshop.
Donkey, a small shop for everyday things.

Orders arrive in 3 to 5 days. We post to mainland UK addresses with a tracked service, and you will get the tracking number by email the day your parcel leaves us. Postage is £3.95 on orders under £30, and free above that.

Changed your mind? Send anything back within 30 days, as long as it is unused and still in its packaging. Email us with your order number and we will send a returns label. Refunds go back to the card you paid with within 5 working days of the parcel reaching us.
